name: House
description: A 2 × 2 dwelling for five residents (Housing, stage 12). Three looks for poorer and richer districts.

variants.name: Half-timbered with thatch
variants.notes: Revision 2 (owner: improve, more detail): diagonal braces in the timber frame, shutter pairs and flower boxes, a framed door with a plank canopy and a stone step, a ridge cap and a chimney; a bench by the door, a woodpile with a chopping block and a rain barrel. Revision 3 (owner: no torch): the door/shed torch is gone.
